description: This file contains internal class implementations for various extension types such as TestExtension, SimpleExtension, AutoExtension, and a generic extension class, all implementing respective interfaces and interacting with grain objects and factories.

classes.name: TestExtension
classes.description: Implements ITestExtension, interacts with ExtensionTestGrain and IGrainFactory to perform extension-related tests.

classes.name: SimpleExtension
classes.description: Implements ISimpleExtension, encapsulates a string and returns it in extension method.

classes.name: AutoExtension
classes.description: Implements IAutoExtension, provides a simple extension method returning a fixed string.

classes.name: GenericTestExtension<T>
classes.description: A generic extension class implementing IGenericTestExtension, interacts with GenericExtensionTestGrain and IGrainFactory, returning properties and sending messages.

methods.name: TestExtension
methods.description: Constructor initializing grain and grainFactory fields.

methods.name: CheckExtension_1
methods.description: Returns the ExtensionProperty of the grain.

methods.name: CheckExtension_2
methods.description: Obtains a grain with ID 23 and retrieves its label.

methods.name: GenericTestExtension
methods.description: Constructor initializes grain and grainFactory fields.

methods.name: CheckExtension_1
methods.description: Returns the ExtensionProperty of the generic grain.

methods.name: CheckExtension_2
methods.description: Gets a grain with ID 24 and retrieves its label.
